title: frontend/src must not import from products/* (duplicate small pure helpers instead)
answers: can I import a helper from products/workflows into frontend/src
reuse buildDelayExpression in the email templater
cross-product import rule in the frontend
body:
Frontend rules forbid importing across `products/*` into `frontend/src`. Importing a helper from a product logic file (e.g. `buildDelayExpression` in products/workflows stepDelayLogic) would also pull in a kea logic module connected to `workflowLogic`.
Pattern used: write a small pure helper next to the consumer (`buildPersonPropertyMergeValue` in frontend/src/scenes/hog-functions/email-templater/emailTemplaterLogic.tsx) and add a comment pointing to the sibling implementation, so the two stay in sync by hand.
If you change the quoting/escaping in one of them, check the other.
applies: Shared logic between frontend/src scenes and products/* frontends
